What is a submarine czar, and why was

the direct report portfolio managers, or
we call them DERPUMs,
>> But the submarine czar is a much better

the critical major weapon systems, which

then the third leg of the strategic

know, you see that nuclear strategic

uh to stand up Golden Dome, and then to,

that we need to pull moving in the right

I think as long as we keep thinking

uh there's a there's a couple

periodic maintenance. Uh maybe to repair

opportunity to take obsolete parts where

at the facility here obsolete parts, and

this plant.

the way we've structured this is

integrated system. And so when you build

that end state. So um I do think there

those drone capabilities are typically a

ship, you know, with with humans on
board is that they are multi-mission
systems. You know, so they're not just a

things.

also they the submarines can be the

um you know, you're you're endeavoring

what has to go right to make this model

what's you know, maybe what's one

US?

Like the amount of software engineers

the things up and the amount of

national mission and it's all about the

We've already proven that we can do this
in different states. I think
people
do not understand how complicated a
submarine is to construct and design.
And secondly, if you think about easy
manufacturing and difficult
manufacturing and maybe you put Starship

submarines in terms of tolerancing,
precision, and quality and welding are

So to do something like this for the
first time ever
that's not, you know, the the private

knowledge transfer is a huge deal. Cuz
it's not just making this stuff the
level of precision and quality we have
to operate here is
as hard if not more difficult as
building building a rocket or something

very serious endeavor because
this man has to send a bunch of sailors

Uh we are just incredibly fortunate to

country. Both of you gentlemen, I want
to thank you for being here for
everything you're doing for uh for our
